coverage.method: Director Compensation tables from every definitive proxy filed 2019-2026 (DEF 14A 2019-03-07, 2020-03-05, 2021-03-04, 2022-03-11, 2023-03-10, 2024-03-18, 2025-03-17, 2026-03-16), one table per fiscal year FY2018-FY2025 (calendar years): 102 rows (14, 14, 12, 12, 12, 13, 14, 11). Every table prints all seven SEC columns; option, non-equity incentive and pension/NQDC are $0 for every director, and every row's components sum exactly to its printed total. Rows were parsed from the sec_text output and each quote is the full printed row (name, any footnote marker, seven figures). Employee directors (James Quincey; Muhtar Kent as employee Chairman through the 2019 Annual Meeting; Henrique Braun, who joined in 2026) are excluded by the proxies. Checked with no director table: every DEFA14A filed 2019-2026 (2-3 per year; short supplements and notices) and the PX14A6G exempt solicitations; no PRE 14A, DEFR14A or 10-K/A was filed in the period (EDGAR submissions feed fetched 2026-10-14). Fiscal year ends December 31 (10-K report dates). Richard M. Daley and Sam Nunn left in April 2019, before the board file's history window, so they get new keys with CIKs from their 2019-04-01 Form 4s.
